dhpak1.3:2.2: Manopubbaṅgamā dhammāti dutiyagāthāpi sāvatthiyaṃyeva maṭṭhakuṇḍaliṃ ārabbha bhāsitā.
dhpak1.3:3.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ kira adinnapubbako nāma brāhmaṇo ahosi.
dhpak1.3:3.2: Tena kassaci kiñci na dinnapubbaṃ, tena taṃ “ adinnapubbako ” tveva sañjāniṃsu.
dhpak1.3:3.3: Tassa ekaputtako ahosi piyo manāpo. Athassa pilandhanaṃ kāretukāmo
dhpak1.3:3.4: “ sace suvaṇṇakāre kāressāmi, bhattavetanaṃ dātabbaṃ bhavissatī ” ti
dhpak1.3:3.5: sayameva suvaṇṇaṃ koṭṭetvā maṭṭhāni kuṇḍalāni katvā adāsi.
dhpak1.3:4.2: Tassa mātā puttaṃ oloketvā,“ brāhmaṇa, puttassa te rogo uppanno, tikicchāpehi nan ” ti āha.
dhpak1.3:4.3: “ Bhoti sace vejjaṃ ānessāmi, bhattavetanaṃ dātabbaṃ bhavissati; kiṃ tvaṃ mama dhanacchedaṃ na olokessasī ” ti?
dhpak1.3:4.4: “ Atha naṃ kiṃ karissasi, brāhmaṇā ” ti? “ Yathā me dhanacchedo na hoti, tathā karissāmī ” ti.
dhpak1.3:4.5: So vejjānaṃ santikaṃ gantvā “ asukarogassa nāma tumhe kiṃ bhesajjaṃ karothā ” ti pucchi.
dhpak1.3:4.6: Athassa te yaṃ vā taṃ vā rukkhatacādiṃ ācikkhanti.
dhpak1.3:5.2: Taṃ karontassevassa rogo balavā ahosi, atekicchabhāvaṃ upāgami.
dhpak1.3:5.3: Brāhmaṇo tassa dubbalabhāvaṃ ñatvā ekaṃ vejjaṃ pakkosi.
dhpak1.3:5.4: So taṃ oloketvāva “ amhākaṃ ekaṃ kiccaṃ atthi,
dhpak1.3:5.5: aññaṃ vejjaṃ pakkositvā tikicchāpehī ” ti taṃ pahāya nikkhami.
dhpak1.3:5.7: “ imassa dassanatthāya āgatā antogehe sāpateyyaṃ passissanti, bahi naṃ karissāmī ” ti
dhpak1.3:6.5: Maṭṭhakuṇḍalī bahiāḷinde nipannākāreneva tassa anto paññāyi.
dhpak1.3:6.6: Satthā taṃ disvā tassa antogehā nīharitvā tattha nipajjāpitabhāvaṃ
dhpak1.3:6.7: ñatvā “ atthi nu kho mayhaṃ ettha gatapaccayena attho ” ti upadhārento
dhpak1.3:7.1: idaṃ addasa – ayaṃ māṇavo mayi cittaṃ pasādetvā kālaṃ katvā
dhpak1.3:7.2: tāvatiṃsadevaloke tiṃsayojanike kanakavimāne nibbattissati, accharāsahassaparivāro bhavissati,
dhpak1.3:7.3: brāhmaṇopi taṃ jhāpetvā rodanto āḷāhane vicarissati.
dhpak1.3:7.6: oloketvā “ kena nu kho kammena mayā ayaṃ sirisampatti laddhā ” ti oloketvā
dhpak1.3:7.8: “ ayaṃ brāhmaṇo dhanacchedabhayena mama bhesajjamakatvā idāni āḷāhanaṃ gantvā rodati,
dhpak1.3:7.9: vippakārappattaṃ naṃ karissāmī ” ti pitari rodante maṭṭhakuṇḍalivaṇṇena
dhpak1.3:8.1: Atha naṃ brāhmaṇo “ kosi tvan ” ti pucchissati. “ Ahaṃ te putto maṭṭhakuṇḍalī ” ti ācikkhissati.
dhpak1.3:8.5: Brāhmaṇo “ tumhesu cittaṃ pasādetvā sagge nibbatto nāma atthī ” ti maṃ pucchissati.
dhpak1.3:8.6: Athassāhaṃ “ ettakāni satāni vā sahassāni vā satasahassāni vāti na sakkā gaṇanā paricchinditun ” ti vatvā
dhpak1.3:8.9: maṭṭha kuṇḍalī sotāpanno bhavissati. Tathā adinnapubbako brāhmaṇo.
dhpak1.3:8.10: Iti imaṃ kulaputtaṃ nissāya mahādhammābhisamayo bhavissatīti disvā
dhpak1.3:9.2: sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pavisitvā anupubbena brāhmaṇassa gehadvāraṃ gato.
dhpak1.3:9.3: Tasmiṃ khaṇe maṭṭhakuṇḍalī antogehābhimukho nipanno hoti.
dhpak1.3:10.1: Athassa satthā attano apassanabhāvaṃ ñatvā ekaṃ rasmiṃ vissajjesi.
dhpak1.3:10.2: Māṇavo “ kiṃ obhāso nāmeso ” ti parivattetvā nipannova satthāraṃ disvā,“ andhabālapitaraṃ nissāya
dhpak1.3:10.3: evarūpaṃ buddhaṃ upasaṅkamitvā kāyaveyyāvaṭikaṃ vā kātuṃ dānaṃ vā dātuṃ dhammaṃ vā sotuṃ nālatthaṃ,
dhpak1.3:10.5: aññaṃ kattabbaṃ natthī ” ti manameva pasādesi.
dhpak1.3:10.6: Satthā “ alaṃ ettakena cittappasādena imassā ” ti pakkāmi.
dhpak1.3:11.4: Brāhmaṇopissa sarīraṃ jhāpetvā āḷāhane rodanaparāyaṇo ahosi,
dhpak1.3:11.5: devasikaṃ āḷāhanaṃ gantvā rodati – “ kahaṃ ekaputtaka, kahaṃ ekaputtakā ” ti.
dhpak1.3:12.1: Devaputtopi attano sampattiṃ oloketvā,“ kena me kammena laddhā ” ti upadhārento
dhpak1.3:12.3: “ ayaṃ brāhmaṇo mama aphāsukakāle bhesajjamakāretvā idāni āḷāhanaṃ gantvā rodati,
dhpak1.3:12.5: maṭṭhakuṇḍalivaṇṇena āgantvā āḷāhanassāvidūre bāhā paggayha rodanto aṭṭhāsi.
dhpak1.3:12.6: Brāhmaṇo taṃ disvā “ ahaṃ tāva puttasokena rodāmi, esa kimatthaṃ rodati,
dhpak1.3:12.7: pucchissāmi nan ” ti pucchanto imaṃ gāthamāha –
dhpak1.3:13.4: Vanamajjhe kiṃ dukkhito tuvan ” ti.(vi. va.1207; pe. va.186);
dhpak1.3:15.4: Tena dukkhena jahāmi jīvitan ” ti.(va.1208; pe. va.187);
dhpak1.3:17.4: Cakkayugaṃ paṭipādayāmi te ” ti.(vi. va.1209; pe. va.188);
dhpak1.3:18.1: Taṃ sutvā māṇavo “ ayaṃ brāhmaṇo puttassa bhesajjamakatvā puttapatirūpakaṃ
dhpak1.3:18.2: maṃ disvā rodanto ‘ suvaṇṇādimayaṃ rathacakkaṃ karomī ’ ti vadati,
dhpak1.3:18.3: hotu niggaṇhissāmi nan ” ti cintetvā “ kīva mahantaṃ me cakkayugaṃ karissasī ” ti vatvā “ yāva mahantaṃ ākaṅkhasi,
dhpak1.3:18.4: tāva mahantaṃ karissāmī ” ti vutte “ candimasūriyehi me attho,
dhpak1.3:18.5: te me dehī ” ti yācanto āha –
dhpak1.3:19.4: Tena cakkayugena sobhatī ” ti.(vi. va.1210; pe. va.189);
dhpak1.3:21.4: Na hi tvaṃ lacchasi candasūriye ” ti.(vi. va.1211; pe. va.190);
dhpak1.3:22.1: Atha naṃ māṇavo āha – “ Kiṃ pana paññāyamānassatthāya rodanto bālo hoti,
dhpak1.3:23.4: Ko nidha kandataṃ bālyataro ” ti.(vi. va.1212; pe. va.191);
dhpak1.3:25.4: Petaṃ kālakatābhipatthayin ” ti.(vi. va.1213; pe. va.192)–
dhpak1.3:26.2: māṇavassa thutiṃ karonto imā gāthā abhāsi –
dhpak1.3:27.1: “ Ādittaṃ vata maṃ santaṃ, ghatasittaṃva pāvakaṃ;
dhpak1.3:27.2: Vārinā viya osiñcaṃ, sabbaṃ nibbāpaye daraṃ.
dhpak1.3:28.1: “ Abbahī vata me sallaṃ, sokaṃ hadayanissitaṃ;
dhpak1.3:29.2: Na socāmi na rodāmi, tava sutvāna māṇavā ” ti.(vi. va.1214-1216; pe. va.193-195);
dhpak1.3:30.1: Atha naṃ “ ko nāma tvan ” ti pucchanto –
dhpak1.3:31.2: Ko vā tvaṃ kassa vā putto, kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayan ” ti.(vi. va.1217; pe. va.196)–
dhpak1.3:33.4: Tidasānaṃ sahabyataṃ gato ” ti.(vi. va.1218; pe. va.197)–
dhpak1.3:35.4: Kena kammena gatosi devalokan ” ti.(vi. va.1219; pe. va.198);
dhpak1.3:38.4: Tidasānaṃ sahabyataṃ gato ” ti.(vi. va.1220-1221; pe. va.199-200);
dhpak1.3:39.1: Tasmiṃ kathenteyeva brāhmaṇassa sakalasarīraṃ pītiyā paripūri.
dhpak1.3:40.4: Ajjeva buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ vajāmī ” ti.(vi. va.1222; pe. va.201)–
dhpak1.3:43.4: Sakena dārena ca hohi tuṭṭho ” ti.(vi. va.1223-1224; pe. va.202-203)–
dhpak1.3:44.1: Āha. So “ sādhū ” ti sampaṭicchitvā imā gāthā abhāsi –
dhpak1.3:45.2: Karomi tuyhaṃ vacanaṃ, tvaṃsi ācariyo mama.
dhpak1.3:47.4: Sakena dārena ca homi tuṭṭho ” ti.(vi. va.1225-1227; pe. va.204-206);
dhpak1.3:48.1: Atha naṃ devaputto,“ brāhmaṇa, te gehe bahuṃ dhanaṃ atthi,
dhpak1.3:48.2: satthāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā dānaṃ dehi, dhammaṃ suṇāhi,
dhpak1.3:48.3: pañhaṃ pucchāhī ” ti vatvā tattheva antaradhāyi.
dhpak1.3:48.4: Brāhmaṇopi gehaṃ gantvā brāhmaṇiṃ āmantetvā,“ bhadde,
dhpak1.3:48.5: ahaṃ ajja samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ nimantetvā pañhaṃ pucchissāmi,
dhpak1.3:48.6: sakkāraṃ karohī ” ti vatvā vihāraṃ gantvā satthāraṃ neva abhivādetvā na paṭisanthāraṃ katvā ekamantaṃ ṭhito,“ bho gotama,
dhpak1.3:48.7: adhivāsehi ajjatanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenā ” ti āha. Satthā adhivāsesi.
dhpak1.3:48.8: So satthu adhivāsanaṃ viditvā vegenāgantvā sake nivesane paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyañca paṭiyādāpesi.
dhpak1.3:49.1: Satthā bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto tassa gehaṃ gantvā paññattāsane nisīdi.
dhpak1.3:50.1: Micchādiṭṭhikena kira tathāgate nimantite dve janakāyā
dhpak1.3:50.2: sannipatanti micchādiṭṭhikā “ ajja samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ pañhaṃ
dhpak1.3:50.4: sammādiṭṭhikā “ ajja buddhavisayaṃ buddhalīḷaṃ passissāmā ” ti sannipatanti.
dhpak1.3:51.2: nīcāsane nisinno pañhaṃ pucchi – “ bho gotama,
dhpak1.3:51.4: dhammaṃ asutvā uposathavāsaṃ avasitvā kevalaṃ manopasādamatteneva sagge nibbattā nāma hontī ” ti? “ Brāhmaṇa, kasmā maṃ pucchasi,
dhpak1.3:51.5: nanu te puttena maṭṭhakuṇḍalinā mayi manaṃ pasādetvā attano sagge nibbattabhāvo kathito ” ti?
dhpak1.3:51.6: “ Kadā, bho gotamā ” ti? Nanu tvaṃ ajja susānaṃ gantvā kandanto
dhpak1.3:51.7: avidūre bāhā paggayha kandantaṃ ekaṃ māṇavaṃ disvā
dhpak1.3:51.9: dvīhi janehi kathitakathaṃ pakāsento sabbaṃ maṭṭhakuṇḍalivatthuṃ kathesi. Tenevetaṃ buddhabhāsitaṃ nāma jātaṃ.
dhpak1.3:52.1: Taṃ kathetvā ca pana “ na kho, brāhmaṇa, ekasataṃ vā na dvesataṃ,
dhpak1.3:52.2: atha kho mayi manaṃ pasādetvā sagge nibbattānaṃ gaṇanā nāma natthī ” ti āha.
dhpak1.3:52.5: maṭṭhakuṇḍalidevaputto vimāneneva saddhiṃ āgacchatū ” ti adhiṭṭhāsi. So tigāvutappamāṇeneva dibbābharaṇapaṭimaṇḍitena attabhāvena āgantvā
dhpak1.3:52.6: vimānato oruyha satthāraṃ vanditvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
dhpak1.3:52.7: Atha naṃ satthā “ tvaṃ imaṃ sampattiṃ kiṃ kammaṃ katvā paṭilabhī ” ti pucchanto –
dhpak1.3:53.1: “ Abhikkantena vaṇṇena, yā tvaṃ tiṭṭhasi devate;
dhpak1.3:53.2: Obhāsentī disā sabbā, osadhī viya tārakā;
dhpak1.3:53.3: Pucchāmi taṃ deva mahānubhāva, manussabhūto kimakāsi puññan ” ti.
dhpak1.3:54.1: Gāthamāha. “ Devaputto ayaṃ me, bhante, sampatti tumhesu cittaṃ pasādetvā laddhā ” ti.
dhpak1.3:54.2: “ Mayi cittaṃ pasādetvā laddhā te ” ti? “ Āma, bhante ” ti.
dhpak1.3:55.1: Mahājano devaputtaṃ oloketvā “ acchariyā vata, bho, buddhaguṇā,
dhpak1.3:55.3: aññaṃ kiñci puññaṃ akatvā satthari cittaṃ pasādetvā evarūpaṃ sampattiṃ paṭilabhī ” ti
dhpak1.3:55.5: manova pubbaṅgamo, manova seṭṭho. Pasannena hi manena kataṃ kammaṃ devalokaṃ manussalokaṃ gacchantaṃ puggalaṃ
dhpak1.3:57.2: Manasā ce pasannena, bhāsati vā karoti vā;
dhpak1.3:57.3: Tato naṃ sukhamanveti, chāyāva anapāyinī ” ti.
dhpak1.3:58.2: Manasā ce pasannena, bhāsati vā karoti vā;
dhpak1.3:58.3: Tato naṃ sukhamanveti, chāyāva anapāyinī ” ti.
dhpak1.3:59.2: maṭṭhakuṇḍalidevaputto sotāpattiphale patiṭṭhahi, tathā adinnapubbako brāhmaṇo.
